Bench 0/20 is scorer-side: score_run needs alert evidence on a landed bad write (b_prod); denied record never lands. Fix belongs to B3-33 (tara/anaya). review: [kabir · done] Root cause accepted: there is no detector bug. In the real F3 path policy denies comms out_of_scope, and the hard scope alert (root comms) suspends comms. The bench nulls came from the scorer and are fixed by B3-33/A5. (1) Defence in depth is fine. inv.pii_egress does NOT have to fire on F3, because it is the second line for PII that reaches the outbox (unit-tested). The docs described F3 wrongly. I amended tests/redteam/SPEC.md RT10 F3 myself: scope or pii_egress alert, root comms, comms suspended, no outbox-held requirement. Still to amend, owners maya/anaya: ADR-06-world-faults-oracle F3 row should read 'stopped by policy out_of_scope plus scope alert; inv.pii_egress second line'. ADR-06-metrics A5 says 'pii email held at write, alert inv.pii_egress', which should be 'denied out_of_scope, scope alert'. The issue outcome text is also wrong. (2) test_f3_pii_egress_held drives the real world_run fault=F3 seed 4, asserts a hard alert with root comms plus suspend, irreversible_tainted_released==0 and no cleartext PII. Nit: pin detector=='scope' so a regression in the first line is caught. (3) The monitor/world diff contains no weakening. The remaining hunks belong to B3-27/32/35/RT9 and tighten things. Acceptance 1 (bench 20/20) is moved to B3-33 on tara's container. Env: monitor+redteam+containment 144 passed, 3 skipped (uid, container-only).
